name: STARFISH
author: Starfish Project
tagline: 8-voice VA synth, 10-kit drum machine, arp and dual LFOs for FM-1
description: STARFISH turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an 8-voice virtual analog synthesizer with dual multimode filters, 10 synthesized drum kits, 64-step drum & 256-event synth sequencer, arpeggiator, chord memory, dual LFO modulation, stereo FX, and 288 curated presets across Banks A-I plus 128 flash user slots in Bank X.
credits: Includes 288 curated presets across Banks A-I plus 128 Bank X user slots.
